rows.transcript_1:
Close your eyes.  

Take a moment to stop what you are doing and connect with your breath.   

What is one thing you can be grateful for right now?  
What is one thing that brings you happiness?  
What is one thing that you love?  

They do not have to be big. Sometimes the small things in life count the most!
rows.transcript_2:
Tutup mata anda.

Ambil sedikit masa untuk berhenti seketika dan fokuskan perhatian anda kepada pernafasan anda.

Fikirkan di dalam hati:

Apakah satu perkara yang anda rasa bersyukur saat ini.

Apakah satu perkara yang membawa kegembiraan kepada anda hari ini.

Apakah satu perkara yang anda sayangi.

Ia tidak perlu sesuatu yang besar. Kadang-kadang perkara kecil dalam hiduplah yang paling bermakna.

Bila anda sudah bersedia, buka semula mata anda perlahan-lahan.

quiz_1_question.eng: True or False: Children learn more when they are told what to do instead of letting them explore and play.

quiz_1_feedback_1.eng:
❌ That’s incorrect. 

🌷 Did you know that children naturally explore the world around them creatively?

🎨 Research shows that children learn best when doing things instead of listening to instructions.

🧸 Creating opportunities for your child to explore the world through play is the best way to help them learn!

text_1_facilitator.eng: 2️⃣ Here are 2 tips on how you can make learning playful and fun with your child.

rows.text_1_facilitator: 2️⃣ Here are 2 tips on how you can make learning playful and fun with your child.

section_1_text.eng:
⚽ Create time and have fun playing games with your child! 
🌱 This has benefits, like improving their physical and mental health, and helping them to learn and remember important facts better! 
⏰ If your child starts to feel overwhelmed, take a pause or play together to help calm them. 
💡 Take note of your child’s interests and use those in your play. This keeps them engaged!

section_2_text.eng:
🎨 Allow your child to be creative when playing. For example, encourage your child to draw or go outside.
✨ If your child is interested in a new topic, talk to them about it and help them explore the topic through play.
💙 Set a good example: Let your child see you being creative and trying something new, even if you are not good at it yet.
